Tick what your project already does. Then pick **one** thing to start with this week.

## 1. Structure

☐ My raw data is never edited

☐ Raw data, cleaned data, code and results are kept in separate places

☐ My files have clear names (no `final_v2` or `copy of`)

☐ I could re-make my results from the raw data

## 2. Documentation

☐ There is a README that says what the project is and how to run it

☐ My columns are explained in a data dictionary

☐ My report is made from the data and code, so nothing is copied and pasted

## 3. Environments

☐ I have written down which software and versions I used

☐ My packages are recorded in a file

☐ A colleague could run my project on a new computer

## 4. Sharing

☐ My data is saved in an open format such as CSV

☐ I know where I would share my data, and under which licence

☐ Someone else could find, understand and reuse it
